lines.intro: A fizzy frog bounces across the sand, puffing pink bubbles!

soothe.great: Fae hums a slow, soft song. The frog's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The frog wobbles and listens.
soothe.miss: Fae hums, but the frog is too fizzy to hear much.

play.great: Maddie chases the bubbles in a happy zig-zag. The frog giggles!
play.good: Maddie bats at a bubble. The frog can't help smiling.
play.miss: Maddie pounces... and lands in a puddle. The frog snorts a little laugh.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber into a tide pool. The frog chases the ripples, giggling!
cast.good: Sue's bobber bobs past. The frog can't stop watching it.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber plops into the sand. The frog blinks... and almost smiles.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The frog's eyes follow every one, round and round!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone high. The frog watches it spin.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pinecones bonk together and tumble. The frog snorts a bubbly laugh.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. Energy up! The frog sniffs, curious.
lines.burst: The frog puffs a stream of pink bubbles at Fae!

burstResult.great: Pop, pop, pop! Fae pops every single bubble!
burstResult.good: Fae pops most of the bubbles!
burstResult.miss: Splish! The bubbles fizz all over Fae.

lines.soothed: The frog lets out a happy croak. The fizzy spell floats away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away slowly. The frog keeps bouncing around.
